body:
Changing the drawing for `get_line_background_color` affects the error line highlight, but the error line should stop at the gutter to match the 4.5.1 behavior.

There are two PRs for this opened around the same time. Since @Manik2607 commented first and their PR https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115729 is closer to the expected behavior, we will probably be going with that one. This was a good attempt though!
